-- Cancel the test row (Direct Test / directtest100@test.com)
UPDATE leadSequenceQueue 
SET status = 'cancelled', cancelReason = 'test_row_excluded', cancelledAt = NOW()
WHERE createdBy = 'blast_jun09_2026' AND leadId = 270002;

-- Cancel the typo email row (gmaol.com)
UPDATE leadSequenceQueue 
SET status = 'cancelled', cancelReason = 'invalid_email_typo_gmaol', cancelledAt = NOW()
WHERE createdBy = 'blast_jun09_2026' AND leadId = 270004;

-- Tag the typo lead for manual correction
UPDATE leads SET tags = JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(COALESCE(tags, '[]'), '$', 'email_typo_needs_fix')
WHERE id = 270004;

-- Verify final active count
SELECT COUNT(*) as active_blast_count FROM leadSequenceQueue 
WHERE createdBy = 'blast_jun09_2026' AND status = 'scheduled';
